**What command did you run?**

```
hindsight ...
```

**What did you expect, and what did you get instead?**

**Wallet address** (public address only -- never a private key or seed
phrase, and hindsight will never ask for one):

**Chain and RPC endpoint** (`--chain`, `--rpc` / `HINDSIGHT_RPC_URL`, or
the default):

**Does `hindsight demo` work correctly?** This tells us whether the bug is
in the pipeline itself or specific to live data / a specific RPC provider.

**hindsight version** (`git rev-parse HEAD` or the release tag) and Node
version (`node --version`):

**Anything else relevant** -- a specific transaction hash the numbers look
wrong for is the single most useful thing you can include.
